label: Search index mapping types: type, child (object), collection, XATTRs
type: scheme. All four mapping kinds can be static (only indexes specified fields) or dynamic (indexes everything); object and XATTRs mappings sharesOptionSetWith collection mappings. A type mapping controls document inclusion/exclusion for the whole index; a child (object) mapping nests inside it for a field that contains a JSON object; a collection mapping is the top-level per-collection default; XATTRs mapping (7.6.2+) is a distinct fourth kind for extended attributes.
relates_to_competency_question: How many distinct kinds of mapping does a Search index configuration have, and how do they nest?
